snippet.title: One's Own Exile - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
One's Own Exile is a narrative exploration game in which you must abandon your identity in order to escape across the border without being noticed.

The game was awarded #2 at Criar Jogos Game Jam 2024 and featured in Gamescom Latam Panorama Brasil. Check it out now on steam and itch.io for free!

itch.io: https://updogsoftware.itch.io/ones-own-exile
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3086720/Ones_Own_Exile/
